messages:
jordan: Quick thread to finalize HW onramp private offer: staggered discounts, SI incentives, and announcement runway. Need sign-off by EOD.

priya: Main ask from customer: 12mo commit with a soft ramp. How do we model discounts without breaking marketplace field limits?

oliver: Suggest explicit tier SKUs rather than conditional text. Example matrix below we can map to marketplace price fields.
```
SKU: HW-APPL-ONRAMP
Tiers: 75k, 200k, 400k annual commit
Discounts: 18%, 25%, 35%
Onramp: months 1-3 at +5% effective discount (to drive usage), then normalize
Floor: 30% monthly minimum
Grace: 60 days to cure shortfall
```
priya: SI incentive idea: $8k onboarding credit + $3k milestone success fee (post-GO live). Cap: first 4 deals per SI in first 6 months.

melissa: Legal prefers credits non-transferable, expire after 180 days, and applied to invoices only. Also avoid the word "penalty" in docs; use "post-commit consumption adjustment."

jordan: Ops check: can marketplace show a two-stage price (onramp + steady)? If not we must submit separate SKUs and a mapping doc.

marketplace-bot: ticket_created: "SKU mapping request - HW-APPL-ONRAMP". Ticket #77890. Assignees: oliver, ops. Due: 2024-08-02.

oliver: Finance ok with floors but wants automatic mid-term conversion: if usage >= 110% of floor for 2 months, allow retroactive upgrade to next tier and credit difference. Limits abuse risk and rewards growth.

priya: Marketing needs co-announcement assets 12 business days before listing; field requests 6 localizable slides.

melissa: I'll draft conservative renewal language: unused onboarding credits may be offered as a renewal credit only if customer opts into renewal within 90 days. I'll post redlines in ticket #77890.

jordan: Action items:
- oliver: submit SKU mapping + pricing spreadsheet to #77890 by 2024-07-25
- priya: SI credit T&Cs draft by 2024-07-22
- melissa: legal redlines by 2024-07-23
- marketing: co-announce templates by 2024-08-01

priya: One more: fallback for under-delivery after grace -> 10% post-commit adjustment or option to convert to lower tier pro-rated. Use plain language in customer-facing docs.

jordan: Good. I'll consolidate and share the pilot brief. Thanks team!
